## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint and tests)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test
- [ ] Visual changes: screenshots at phone and desktop width
- [ ] Music: every chord, note and count I added or changed is checked — by ear, on an instrument, or against a source
- [ ] I've read CONTRIBUTING.md, and my contribution is under the project's MIT License
